embed.title: !info
embed.description: Look up pokemon and game data. Nothing here changes your tracking.

fields.name: Pokemon
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}info pikachu` — by name or dex number (`{{prefix}}info 25`): types, weather boosts, weaknesses and resistances, base stats, generation, evolutions, recently seen forms and costumes, shiny rate, and 100% IV CP at levels 15, 20, 25, 40, 50 and 51
`{{prefix}}info vulpix forms` — every form, the recently seen ones first, written as the `form:` value to track
`{{prefix}}info pikachu costumes` — costumes seen recently

fields.name: Game data
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}info moves` — move names as used in `move:` filters, with their types
`{{prefix}}info items` — item names
`{{prefix}}info costumes` — every costume, with its ID
`{{prefix}}info weather` — current weather and next-hour forecast at your location, and the types it boosts
`{{prefix}}info weather 51.5,-0.12` — the same for a given point
`{{prefix}}info templates` — the alert templates you can pick with `template:`

fields.name: Statistics
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}info rarity` — pokemon grouped by how often they spawn here, common to ultra-rare
`{{prefix}}info shiny` — shiny rates seen on this server

fields.name: {{#if userIsAdmin}}Admins{{/if}}
fields.value:
{{#if userIsAdmin}}`{{prefix}}info dts` — every loaded template by type and platform
`{{prefix}}info translate <word>` — look up a word in the translations{{/if}}

fields.name: Related
fields.value: `{{prefix}}help track` — use what you found here in tracking rules
